dept_candidates.name: dept_candidates
dept_candidates.body_sql: SELECT `sis_department`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `department_key`, `sis_department`.`DEPARTMENT_NAME` AS `department_name`, `fac_building_address`.`ADDRESS_PURPOSE` AS `address_purpose` FROM `sis_department` JOIN `fac_building_address` ON `sis_department`.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` = `fac_building_address`.`BUILDING_KEY`
dept_candidates.description: departments with their address purpose attributes
